title: Anthropic Watermarks All Claude Outputs — Invisibly, Globally
subtitle: Every text response from Claude now carries a hidden statistical signature designed to survive copying and editing. The policy went live on August 2 in response to the EU AI Act, but applies worldwide.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: Anthropic began watermarking all Claude-generated text on August 2, 2026, using invisible statistical biases in word selection that persist through copying and editing. The policy is global and applies to all Claude platforms.

title: The EU AI Act Is Now Being Enforced — Here Is What That Means
subtitle: As of August 2, 2026, the European Commission's AI Office has formal powers to investigate and fine AI providers. The rules on transparency and content labelling are active. Fines can reach 3% of global turnover.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: The EU AI Act entered active enforcement on August 2, 2026. Transparency obligations are now live, fines can reach 15 million euros or 3% of global revenue, and generative AI providers must label synthetic content in machine-readable formats.

title: SpaceX Sets New World Record: Two Rockets, 38 Minutes Apart
subtitle: On August 15, Falcon 9 boosters launched from opposite coasts of the United States in the tightest back-to-back orbital launch window ever recorded.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: SpaceX launched two Falcon 9 rockets just 38 minutes apart on August 15, 2026 — one from Cape Canaveral, one from Vandenberg — setting a new world record for the shortest interval between two orbital launches.
